receipts.limitNote: The P1 API returns a batch of up to 100 receipts and does not publish a next-page cursor; the UI does not simulate pagination.
receipts.emptyBody: Run a real Chief turn and try again. The acceptance profile does not inject fixtures.

documents.catalogUnavailableBody: The P1 OpenAPI does not expose the manifest or linter health. The list below only contains documents observed in real receipts, without fabricated owners, authority, or status.
documents.observedBody: Selection, checksum, and budget captured by receipts in the current batch.
documents.findingsBody: Runtime detections grouped by document; no action is performed automatically.

evaluation.title: Fresh-context evaluator
evaluation.body: Submits criteria, diff, and evidence to the independent read-only P1 evaluator. Do not include secrets or classified content.
evaluation.requiredError: Fill in the required identifiers, criteria, diff, and evidence.
evaluation.historyUnavailableBody: P1 only publishes POST /evaluations. The current result remains in the screen session; no list or replay endpoint exists.

hashline.title: Hashline-protected patch
hashline.body: The real write is rejected before changing the file when the checksum diverges. Use only after re-reading the target.
hashline.confirm: I confirm that I re-read the file, validated the relative path, and understand this action can write to the project.

learning.title: P2 contracts are not published yet
